blocks.title: Introduction
blocks.content:
In this paper, we show an asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral basic hypergeometric series $${}_1\psi_0 (a;-;q;x ):=\sum_{n\in\mathbb{Z}} (a;q)_n\left\{(-1)^nq^{\frac{n(n-1)}{2}}\right\}^{-1}x^n.$$ Here, $(a;q)_n$ is the $q$-shifted factorial; $$(a;q)_n:=
\begin{cases}
1, &n=0, \\
(1-a)(1-aq)\dots (1-aq^{n-1}), &n\ge 1,\\
[(1-aq^{-1})(1-aq^{-2})\dots (1-aq^n)]^{-1}, &n\le -1
\end{cases}$$ moreover, $(a;q)_\infty :=\lim_{n\to \infty}(a;q)_n$ and $$(a_1,a_2,\dots ,a_m;q)_\infty:=(a_1;q)_\infty (a_2;q)_\infty \dots (a_m;q)_\infty.$$

Takeshi MORITA∗
Abstract
We show an asymptotic formula of the divergent bilateral basic
hypergeometric series 1ψ0(a; −; q, ·) with using the q-Borel-Laplace
method. We also give the limit q →1 −0 of our asymptotic formula.

blocks.content:
In this section, we show an asymptotic formula of [\[b2so\]](#b2so){reference-type="eqref" reference="b2so"} with using the $q$-Borel-Laplace transformations of the first kind. We show the following theorem.

::: thm
